entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: Information element used to transmit protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events from network to UE when supported end-to-end for the PDN connection.

entities.name: Network wishes to transmit protocol data
entities.description: Condition where network intends to send protocol data to UE and extended protocol configuration options is supported end-to-end for PDN connection.

entities.name: Network supports Local IP address in TFT
entities.description: Condition where network supports Local IP address in traffic flow aggregate description and TFT filter, PDN Type is not Non-IP or Ethernet, and extended protocol configuration options is supported end-to-end.

entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options supported end-to-end
entities.description: Property indicating that both UE and network support extended protocol configuration options for the PDN connection.

relations.description: Extended protocol configuration options IE is included when network wishes to transmit protocol data and end-to-end support exists.
Extended protocol configuration options IE shall be included if network supports Local IP address in TFT, PDN Type is not Non-IP/Ethernet, and end-to-end support exists.
Inclusion of extended protocol configuration options IE requires that both UE and network support it end-to-end for the PDN connection.
